MODE 2: STAT (Statistics)

Statistics editor with 1-VAR (including quartiles) and seven paired regression models.

keys
MODE→2

MODE 2 opens a type menu. After you pick a model, the Statistics Editor appears. Use SHIFT 1 (STAT) menus for Sum, Var, Reg, and MinMax after AC exits the editor.

Example: 1-VAR mean and sx

  1. MODE → 2 → 1 (1-VAR)
  2. 15 =

  5. 25 =
  6. AC → SHIFT 1 (STAT) → 4 (Var) → 2 (x̄) =
  7. SHIFT 1 → 4 (Var) → 4 (sx) =

STAT types

  • 1-VARSingle-variable stats including n, mean, σx/sx, min/max, Q1, median, Q3.
  • A+BXLinear regression y = A + Bx with correlation r and estimators x̂, ŷ.
  • _+CX²Quadratic regression with coefficients A, B, C and dual x̂ estimators.
  • ln XLogarithmic regression y = A + B ln x.
  • e^XNatural exponential regression y = A e^(Bx).
  • A·B^XBase-B exponential regression y = A·B^x.
  • A·X^BPower regression y = A·x^B.
  • 1/XInverse regression y = A + B/x.
